Dividend Rate on Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock On October 15, 2026, Strategy Inc (the "Company") announced that, if the Contingent Dividend Condition (as defined below) is satisfied, the regular dividend rate per annum on the Company’s Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock ("STRC") for dividends with record dates from November 1, 2026 through November 30, 2026 will be 12.00%, as disclosed in the Company’s definitive proxy statement for the Special Meeting (as defined below) filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on October 5, 2026. Such rate shall have no effect on any previously declared but unpaid dividends on STRC. As previously announced, management will recommend to the board of directors that the Company maintain STRC’s regular dividend rate per annum at 12.00% until STRC has demonstrated sustained, healthy trading near $100 per share. Cash Dividend Declaration On October 15, 2026, the Company’s board of directors declared daily cash dividends on STRC for each calendar day from November 1, 2026 through November 30, 2026 (each, a "Record Date"), payable to stockholders of record as of 5:00 p.m., New York City time on the applicable Record Date, subject to the Contingent Dividend Condition described below. Business days exclude days on which the Federal Reserve Bank of New York is closed (including Veterans Day and Thanksgiving Day); accordingly, the dividends for two or more Record Dates may be paid on the same business day. Conditional Dividends As previously announced, the Company has scheduled a special meeting of stockholders to be held on October 28, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time (including any adjournment or postponement thereof, the "Special Meeting"), to consider a proposal to amend and restate the certificates of designations governing STRC (the "Second A&R STRC CoD") and certain of the Company’s other series of preferred stock to provide for a regular dividend record date on each calendar day, with the related dividend, if declared, payable on the next following business day (the "Daily Dividend Amendments"). The daily dividends on STRC described above (the "November Daily Dividends") will be payable only if both of the following events occur (the "Contingent Dividend Condition"): (a) the Daily Dividend Amendments have been approved by the Company’s stockholders at the Special Meeting at or prior to 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 31, 2026; and (b) the Second A&R STRC CoD has been filed and become effective at or prior to 12:01 a.m., Eastern time, on November 1, 2026. If the Contingent Dividend Condition is satisfied, i.e., both the Daily Dividend Amendments pass and the Second A&R STRC CoD is timely filed and effective, then the November Daily Dividends will be payable, and the dividend on STRC which the Company declared on September 30, 2026 (payable on November 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of 5:00 p.m., New York City time on October 31, 2026) (the "November 15 Dividend"), will not be payable. If the Contingent Dividend Condition is not satisfied, the November Daily Dividends will not be payable, the November 15 Dividend will be payable, and the Company expects, subject to approval by its board of directors, to declare dividends on STRC with record dates in the month of November following the current semi-monthly cadence under the existing STRC certificate of designations. In no event will both the November Daily Dividends and the November 15 Dividend become unconditionally payable. Expected Tax Treatment As of October 16, 2026, the Company expects that the November Daily Dividends, if payable, will be characterized as non-taxable returns of capital to the extent of a shareholder’s tax basis in their STRC for U.S. federal income tax purposes. No dividend, interest or other amount will accumulate or accrue on any unpaid regular dividends, regardless of whether regular dividends are declared for any future regular dividend period. Declared regular dividends on the SATS Stock will be payable solely in cash in the manner, and subject to the provisions, described in the Certificate of Designation. The SATS Stock has a par value of $0.001 per share and initially has a liquidation preference of $100 per share, subject to adjustment as set forth below (the "Liquidation Preference"). However, holders of the SATS Stock will not always be entitled to vote with holders of Class A Common Stock on matters on which holders of Class A Common Stock are entitled to vote. docs.text: EX-99.1 3 dp255260_ex9901.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Strive Announces Nasdaq Listing of SATS and Closing of Upsized Initial Public Offering DALLAS, TX, October 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Strive, Inc. ("Strive" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: ASST), announced today the closing of its upsized initial public offering of 7,000,000 shares of Strive’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock (the "SATS Stock"), at a public offering price of $90 per share. The SATS Stock is expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Market on or around October 20, 2026, under the ticker symbol "SATS." "The successful, upsized IPO of SATS marks a critical milestone in our strategy to maximize long-term total returns for our common equity investors," said Matt Cole, Chairman and CEO of Strive. "We believe maintaining a high Amplification Ratio is the most important driver of our ability to outperform Bitcoin over time. SATS provides an additional tool to achieve that objective while simultaneously strengthening SATA’s credit profile by adding junior capital beneath it. With two complementary income securities, SATA designed for price stability and SATS designed for income stability, we believe Strive is better positioned than ever to capitalize on Bitcoin’s long-term growth." The SATS Stock accumulates cumulative dividends at a rate per annum equal to 15.00% on the stated amount of $100 per share (the "stated amount") thereof. If declared in full, the first scheduled regular dividend on the SATS Stock payable will include all accrued and unpaid dividends from and after the closing date. "We believe credit risk is easiest to manage when it is transparent," said Jeff Walton, Chief Risk Officer. "SATS and SATA holders can observe the Bitcoin balance sheet that protects their dividend in real time, priced continuously, not just four times a year. As artificial intelligence and trading algorithms take on more portfolio-level decisions, we think our credit instruments are built for that future, interfacing with humans equipped with advanced compute. We don’t have any debt, or maturities, and we’re focused on a single obligation, the dividend. I believe that is what the best capital structure in the world looks like." "SATS represents the next evolution of our commitment to developing products tailored to the distinct needs of investors, introducing a fixed-rate perpetual security to our offerings," said Ben Werkman, Chief Investment Officer. "By expanding our range of highly liquid securities, we are more precisely aligning each product with the objectives of the investors it serves. This approach reflects our broader vision of building a differentiated family of financial securities combining thoughtful structures, institutional-grade liquidity, and an unwavering commitment to long-term value creation." The offering was conducted pursuant to the Form S-3 registration statement, and was made only by means of a prospectus supplement and an accompanying prospectus. An electronic copy of the final prospectus supplement, together with the accompanying prospectus, is available on the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov . (Nasdaq: ASST) ("Strive" or the "Company") today announced the pricing of its initial public offering (the "offering") on October 15, 2026 of 7,000,000 shares of Strive’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock (the "SATS Stock"), an upsize of 2,000,000 shares over the amount previously announced, at a public offering price of $90 per share. Strive may also use such proceeds to fund acquisitions of businesses, assets or technologies that complement its current business. The SATS Stock will accumulate cumulative dividends at a rate per annum equal to 15.00% on the stated amount of $100 per share (the "stated amount") thereof. Subject to the provisions in the governing documentation for the SATS Stock, regular dividends on the SATS Stock will be payable when, as and if declared by Strive’s board of directors or any duly authorized committee thereof, out of funds legally available for their payment, in arrears for each regular dividend period on each payment date to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the regular record date immediately preceding the applicable regular dividend payment date. Regular dividend dates will fall on each business day, as defined in the governing documentation for the SATS Stock, beginning on November 9, 2026. If declared in full, the first scheduled regular dividend on the SATS Stock payable will include all accrued and unpaid dividends from and after the closing date. At the closing of the offering, Strive intends to increase our existing dividend reserve in an amount equal to the first 18 months of dividend payments calculated as of the date of the offering by depositing an equivalent of $22.50 per share of SATS Stock into an account funded by us with a combination of existing cash on hand and securities held by us (based on the value of such securities at the closing of this offering). Strive will have the right, at its election, to redeem all, but not less than all, of the SATS Stock, at any time, for cash if the total number of shares of all SATS Stock then outstanding is less than 25% of the total number of shares of SATS Stock originally issued in this offering and in any future offering, taken together. In addition, Strive will have the right to redeem all, but not less than all, of the SATS Stock if certain tax events occur. The redemption price for any SATS Stock to be redeemed will be a cash amount equal to the liquidation preference of the SATS Stock to be redeemed as of the business day before the date on which Strive sends the related redemption notice, plus accumulated and unpaid regular dividends, if any, thereon to, and including, the redemption date. If an event that constitutes a "fundamental change" under the certificate of designation governing the SATS Stock occurs, then holders of the SATS Stock will have the right to require Strive to repurchase some or all of their shares of SATS Stock at a cash repurchase price equal to the stated amount of the SATS Stock to be repurchased, plus accumulated and unpaid regular dividends, if any, to, and including, the fundamental change repurchase date. ("Bitmine" or the "Company"), a Bitcoin and Ethereum Network company with a focus on the accumulation of crypto for long term investment, today announced Bitmine crypto + total cash & marketable securities + "moonshots" holdings totaling $15.1 billion. "The risk appetite of investors contracted in the past few weeks fueled by the worrying combination of AI funding and AI model safety; escalating US-Iran war activity; anxiousness in front of US midterm elections and generally rising bond yields around the world. This has triggered a selloff in AI stocks including semis and memory stocks, and has further led to selloffs in the Korean and Taiwan markets, both of which are dominated by semis and memory stocks," stated Thomas "Tom" Lee, Chairman of Bitmine. "Crypto is widely held in the US, Korea and Taiwan. So naturally, when investors in those regions de-risk, this creates spillover pressures in crypto markets. In the past, whenever fundamentals remain resilient and strong, while price declines, these have historically been attractive risk/reward opportunities. And given crypto’s positive exposure to both modernizing global financial system rails and to agentic-AI, we believe this will again prove to be the case," continued Lee. As of October 18, 2026 at 3:00pm ET, the Company’s crypto holdings are comprised of 6,041,481 ETH at $2,365 per ETH (per Coinbase NASDAQ: COIN), 215 Bitcoin (BTC), $180 million stake in Beast Industries, $74 million stake in Eightco Holdings (NASDAQ: ORBS) ("moonshots") and total cash & marketable securities of $582 million. Bitmine’s ETH holdings are 4.9% of the ETH supply (of 122.1 million ETH). "We believe Bitmine is positioned to outperform the crypto bull market that we expect to be coming, as the company has strengthened its competitive position over the past year in the midst of a crypto winter (bear market)," continued Lee. "Over the past week, we acquired 12,535 ETH. Bitmine’s track record of consistent buying of crypto is unmatched by any public company in the world. Bitmine has bought ETH each and every week since the inception of the ETH Treasury Strategy on June 30, 2025," stated Lee. On October 7, Bitmine released its latest Chairman’s message titled "Crypto Bull Underway — This Cycle Likely the Largest." The presentation is available at the Bitmine website ( presentation link ). Earlier in 2026, Bitmine launched MAVAN (the Made in America VAlidator Network), the institutional-grade staking platform. While MAVAN was originally developed to support Bitmine’s own Ethereum treasury, MAVAN has expanded to serve institutional investors, custodians, and ecosystem partners seeking best-in-class staking infrastructure. A portion of Bitmine’s ETH is already staked on the MAVAN platform. As of October 18, 2026, Bitmine total staked ETH stands at 5,067,309 ($12 billion at $2,365 per ETH). "Bitmine has staked more ETH than other entities in the world. At scale (assuming Bitmine’s ETH is fully staked by MAVAN and its staking partners), the projected ETH staking reward would be $369 million on an annualized basis (using 2.58% 7-day BMNR yield). This compares to annualized staking revenues at $309 million based upon 5.1 million staked ETH (84% of the 6.04 million ETH held by Bitmine)," continued Lee. (NYSE: BMNR, NYSE: BMNP) Chairman’s Message — October 2026 "The Crypto Bull Market Is Underway and the Cycle Is Likely to Be the Largest" Video Transcript Tom Lee: Hi there, this is Tom Lee. I’m the Chairman of Bitmine Immersion Technologies, and this is our Chairman’s Message for the month of October 2026. The title of my presentation is "The Crypto Bull Market Is Underway, and the Cycle Is Likely to Be the Largest." There’s a few things I want to cover. The first is to explain to you why a full-blown crypto bull market is underway. Foremost, we have institutions like Franklin Templeton, Fidelity, and others saying that a crypto bull market is underway. That’s never happened in any of the past cycles. Another thing to note is Bitcoin moved above the 200-day moving average on August 19th. That last happened August 24th, 2025, and as you can see on this chart, Bitcoin made a huge move to over 100,000. In fact, since 2010, whenever Bitcoin is above its 200-day moving average, the 6-month forward return averages 193%, with a positive win ratio of 80%. That’s pretty powerful odds. And since 2012, for instance, there have been 9 crosses above the 200-day moving average. Eight of the nine were bull market flags. The flows into Bitcoin ETFs also turned positive year-to-date. That won’t happen in a bear market. And look at performance. In the third quarter, crypto crushed other macro assets by a country mile. Ethereum outperformed the S&P by 6,500 basis points. Keep in mind, this came in the midst of a hawkish Fed, surging oil prices, global bond yields rising, and tightening financial conditions. So the outperformance of crypto in the face of all that is a sign of a bull market. And Tom DeMark, the exclusive advisor to Bitmine, says, "We’re confident that Ethereum markets will continue to trade higher. When a market rallies 100% off the low, it is often an indication of a potential trend reversal." And lastly, keep in mind, October 5th is the cycle bottom of the four-year cycle, meaning the bear market for Bitcoin ended, and a bull market is starting. So, as you can see, it’s all maths. Now, we think this crypto bull market should be larger than the past cycles, basically the biggest bull market we’ve ever seen. And I’ll give you some reasons. The first is tokenization. In our view, tokenization is a far bigger driver than other bull markets. In 2016-2017, it was an ICO boom, primarily retail. In the 2019-2021 era, it was the NFTs, primarily retail. Last year was a stablecoin boom, but it got cut short because of the October 10th massive debt deleveraging slash auto-deleveraging event. But it’s different now. BlackRock wants to put most of its assets as tokenized assets. Robinhood’s Vlad Tenev says we’re at the beginning of a super cycle. In fact, he thinks everything that runs on traditional rails will eventually become on-chain slash tokenized. And it’s a huge addressable market. Total liquid assets globally is around $200 trillion, but just the top three, stocks, bonds, and credit, would be $160 trillion. For every dollar that’s been tokenized or TVL’d on an L1 blockchain, it creates about $1 value for the blockchain. So if 10% moves on-chain, that creates a $16 trillion market. And of course, as you can see, a lot of this is being built on Ethereum, whether it’s BlackRock, JPMorgan, even Robinhood. And Ethereum benefits from the deepest community. More developers combined than every other blockchain. So this is the tokenization wave. It’s institutional, unlike the prior waves. Second, there’s a wealth transfer element here. Vlad Tenev recently mentioned there’s a $100 trillion wealth transfer underway, and I think many investors don’t realize it’s already happening. For instance, in just the last three years, look at that, over a trillion and a half dollars has been inherited from someone who’s passed away, probably someone who’s a baby boomer, to someone who’s a millennial or a Gen X. And that, of course, changes the mix of what they own. In the crypto bull market of 2019-2021, there was some inheritance, but it was a small effect, about $450 billion. But look at this upcoming bull market. There may be as much as $1.5 to $2 trillion being inherited. Again, a pronounced allocation away from credit towards digital assets and equities. I think a lot of this allocation comes from private equity and private credit, which are going to face tremendous headwinds as yields have risen. And keep in mind, there’s institutional FOMO, because if crypto was the best performing macro asset in the midst of financial conditions tightening, imagine what will happen in the fourth quarter, again, as a bull market is starting. The DATs are going to contribute to a larger bull market as well. DATs are a friend in a bull market, although a lot of people question the role of DATs, especially because only four DATs trade above NAV, including Bitmine. These other DATs will recover in the bull market, so think about that. They’re going to be absorbing supply. So in a bull, the DATs support the L1s. For instance, Ethereum DATs combined own $21 billion of Ethereum. That’s 7% less of the network available, and in other bull markets, there wasn’t this entity that absorbed that much supply. So guess what? If demand’s recovering and supply has shrunk, we should expect big price moves. And keep in mind, crypto is an AI downstream story. We’ve talked about this before, but as memory and chips corrected, the Mag 7, software, and crypto should gain, and that’s exactly how it’s played out. And we know why. Agents are going to carry digital wallets, and they’re a rising share of all traffic, and of course, we have to worry about their capabilities. We have to keep humans in the loop. And of course, that’s why crypto plays a role. And that takes us to Bitmine. We think it’s really well positioned to outperform this cycle. So the first thing the company’s doing is maximizing its exposure to ETH in this bull market. Ethereum has been range-bound for the last five years. But it broke out of those ranges in the past. A 227x move in 2016. A 54x move in 2019-2020. And with tokenization and agentic AI, could this be a 25x move? Probably. And look at what happens with Bitmine’s share price. Bitmine is 90% correlated to the move in ETH. So if ETH gets to $22,000, that’s $300 to $500 for Bitmine shares. If ETH gets to $62,000, that’s $1,200 to $1,500 per share. And Bitmine’s currently at $26. Bitmine is also reaching a 5% target of Ethereum supply, because that optimizes shareholder value. The company accomplished a lot in its first year of operations, but notably, we reached almost 6 million ETH. And we’re pretty close to our 5% target. Here’s the progress we made since June 30th of last year, and you can see it took 15 months to get to 6 million ETH. And that all happened in the middle of a bear market. So we need to get about 100,000 more ETH, and that’s about it. Here’s the thing. All that accumulation took place in this bear market here. And now we’re done stacking while a bull market is starting. So if we’re done stacking, but ETH goes up a lot, you can imagine that we’ll outperform Ethereum. And DATs track the price of treasuries, but they should outperform, and that’s what we’ve done. Bitmine outperformed in 2025 by 48,000 basis points versus Ethereum. Think about that. From June 30th to December 31, Ethereum was up 22%. Bitmine was up 500%. And in 2026, in the middle of a bear market, Bitmine was up 3%, while Ethereum’s down 9%. And in total, 53,500 basis points of outperformance since inception. I’d say we’re clearly outperforming ETH. One of the reasons we did that is we executed the largest crypto buyback ever. On July 14th, Bitmine began a stock buyback, which was pretty much at the lows. Then we bought back 21 million shares, the largest crypto buyback ever, $350 million, and we completed that on August 17th. But as you can see, that helped establish the low for Bitmine’s stock price. And we issued an ETH credit. And I don’t know if you’ve really appreciated how much it’s outperformed. We issued this at $80 a share on June 2026, and it’s currently $99. So pretty substantial outperformance. But consider this. It’s been in the middle of a big bond bear market. Treasuries are down 8% in that same timeframe. Investment grade down 6, high yield down 3, and yet Bitmine has gained 24% on price. That is pretty substantial outperformance as credit. And as you can see, the cost of debt for Bitmine’s perpetual preferreds, or the cost of funds, really, is 9.56%. It’s much lower than that of a Bitcoin or a Solana Treasury. And lastly, we want to leverage our substantial scale to optimize opportunities in both tokenization and the Ethereum ecosystem. Foremost is MAVAN. It’s the largest single staking operator in the world, managing $2 billion of other people’s crypto. But as you can see, this is allowing us to also generate substantial staking rewards, about a million dollars per day. And we have our moonshot in Eightco. It’s the largest holder of World tokens. That’s the crypto project founded by Sam Altman, but it owns a big stake in OpenAI. And you can see similar companies are trading at six times NAV. I do think Eightco is a great investment for us. We’re also the largest corporate shareholder in Beast Industries. MrBeast owns and acquires Step Financial. We believe they’re going to be creating a financial services empire that is the Gen Z, Gen Alpha for Robinhood, Chime, and SoFi. And we’ve led the investment in the Ethereum Foundation spin-offs. ETH Labs, Ethereum Institutional, and ETH Systems. We’re the lead investor, of course. We all want to support the ecosystem. So, in conclusion, the big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting, according to Charlie Munger. He is the original HODL. And of course, this is coming at a time when we may have the largest crypto bull market ever. Thanks for listening, and I’ll speak to you soon.

(Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced that its treasury balance increased by 3,983 SOL and SOL equivalents over the past week, bringing total holdings to approximately 2,590,266 SOL and SOL equivalents. The update comes ahead of Alpenglow, a major upgrade to Solana’s consensus protocol scheduled to go live on October 21, 2026. The upgrade targets transaction finality of approximately 150 milliseconds, down from roughly 12.8 seconds, representing a significant advance in how quickly transactions become irreversible on the network. A Faster Foundation for Onchain Finance Alpenglow is one of the most significant upgrades to Solana’s core infrastructure since launch, with a compelling potential outcome for users: Solana transactions that feel as fast as paying with Visa. By targeting approximately 150-millisecond finality, the upgrade aims to combine the responsiveness users expect from card payments with near-instant settlement on a decentralized network operating 24/7. The upgrade arrives as tokenized equities and other real-world assets continue expanding on Solana. For payments, trading and tokenized assets, faster finality reduces the time users and applications must wait for certainty that a transaction is complete. The Company believes this improvement will strengthen Solana’s role as infrastructure for financial markets moving onchain. For DeFi Dev Corp., these developments reinforce the rationale behind its SOL treasury strategy: accumulating and compounding the native asset of a network being built to support increasingly sophisticated financial activity. CHAD Annual Dividend Rate Increasing to 14%, Effective November 2, 2026 The Company recently announced an increase in the annual dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock ("CHAD") from 13.00% to 14.00%, effective November 2, 2026. The 13.00% annual rate remains in effect until that date. "We believe Solana is entering a significant new growth cycle, with Alpenglow advancing the network’s capabilities and tokenization expanding its role in global finance," said Joseph Onorati, Chief Executive Officer of DeFi Dev Corp. "Raising CHAD’s annual dividend rate to 14% strengthens our income offering ahead of what we believe could be a major bull market for SOL. Our goal is to make CHAD more compelling for income investors while expanding our capacity to accumulate SOL for common shareholders." The new rate represents annualized dividends of $1.40 per share, based on CHAD’s $10.00 stated amount—an approximately 7.7% increase in annual dividend income per share. Dividends are cumulative and payable each business day when, as and if declared by the Company’s Board of Directors. Learn more about CHAD at www.defidevcorp.com/chad . For more information, visit defidevcorp.com . To stay up to date with the latest developments and insights, subscribe to our blog . About DeFi Development Corp. DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) has adopted a treasury policy under which the principal holding in its treasury reserve is allocated to SOL. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. The Company’s data and software offerings are generally offered on a subscription basis as software as a service. (Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced that its treasury increased by approximately 22,070 SOL and SOL equivalents over the past week, bringing total holdings to approximately 2,586,282 SOL and SOL equivalents. The latest increase brings total SOL and SOL equivalents growth to approximately 12% since the Company’s Q2 earnings report on August 12. With the recently established $300 million at-the-market offering program (the "CHAD ATM") providing an additional source of growth capital, the Company believes its SOL accumulation flywheel is continuing to gain momentum. "Short-term volatility has not changed our conviction or our commitment to accumulating SOL," said Joseph Onorati, Chief Executive Officer of DeFi Development Corp. "Tokenized equities are generating billions of dollars in trading activity on Solana, stablecoin adoption is reaching new highs, and just last week Samsung announced it is bringing stablecoin functionality across 82 million U.S. Galaxy devices. These developments point toward a much larger role for Solana in global finance, and we intend to keep accumulating and compounding SOL ahead of that opportunity." CHAD Hits All-Time Highs Despite Crypto Selloff CHAD (Nasdaq: CHAD), the Company’s variable-rate perpetual preferred stock, reached new all-time trading highs and gained during the week ended October 9, 2026, despite a broader cryptocurrency selloff. "CHAD reaching new highs and approaching $10.00 even as SOL pulled back is an encouraging sign that investors are recognizing its distinct income proposition," said Dan Kang, Chief Strategy Officer of DeFi Development Corp. "We created CHAD to meet demand for income supported by a productive SOL treasury, and its recent performance demonstrates how its trading behavior can differ from SOL’s. For common shareholders, CHAD provides a funding source that can support accretive SOL per share growth without issuing additional common shares. For CHAD holders, it offers daily income supported by that growing, productive treasury." CHAD currently carries a 13% annual dividend rate on its $10 stated amount, equivalent to $1.30 per share annually at the current rate, with dividend payments continuing each business day when declared. Learn more about CHAD at www.defidevcorp.com/chad . For more information, visit defidevcorp.com . To stay up to date with the latest developments and insights, subscribe to our blog . About DeFi Development Corp. DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) has adopted a treasury policy under which the principal holding in its treasury reserve is allocated to SOL. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. The Company’s data and software offerings are generally offered on a subscription basis as software as a service.
